boot.failed_text: Check your connection and try again.
boot.outside_text: This cookbook works inside Telegram. Open it from the bot to continue.

onboarding.title: Welcome to the family cookbook
onboarding.text: Create a book for your family or join one with an invitation.

join.title: Join this book?
join.text: You will see the recipes members share with the book, and they will see yours.

book.empty_text: Recipes you and your family add will appear here.
book.no_results_text: Try a different word or reset the filters.
book.empty_mine_text: Recipes you write will appear here, drafts included.

recipe.unpublish_confirm: Unpublish this recipe? Only its author will see it.
recipe.delete_confirm: Delete this recipe? This cannot be undone.

saved.title: Saved
saved.empty_text: Recipes you save will appear here.
saved.dev_sample: Development sample: saving recipes arrives in a later sprint.

link_recipe.title: Recipe by link
link_recipe.text: Opening recipes from shared links is coming soon.

profile.title: Profile
profile.language_hint: Recipes are never translated: they stay in the language they were written in.
profile.invite_rotate_text: The old code stops working immediately.
profile.leave_text: Your recipes will leave the book and become private.
profile.keeper_cannot_leave: The keeper cannot leave the book until the role is transferred.
profile.remove_text: {{name}}'s recipes will leave the book and become private.
profile.no_book: You are not in a book yet.
profile.language_not_saved: The language is set on this device but could not be saved to your profile.

errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request could not be processed.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session is invalid. Reopen the app from Telegram.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.ALREADY_IN_BOOK: You are already in a book.
errors.NOT_IN_BOOK: You are not in a book yet.
errors.INVALID_INVITE_CODE: This invitation code is not valid.
errors.KEEPER_CANNOT_LEAVE: The keeper cannot leave the book until the role is transferred.
errors.CONFLICT: That can't be done right now.
errors.NOT_PUBLISHABLE: Add a title, servings, at least one ingredient and one step before publishing.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: This photo is too large. The limit is 10 MB.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_TYPE: This file type is not supported. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.HEIC_NOT_SUPPORTED: HEIC photos (the iPhone format) are not supported yet. Please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.IMAGE_INVALID: This photo could not be read. Try another one.
errors.IMPORT_TIMEOUT: This text took too long to read. Try a shorter text, or split it into several recipes.
errors.IMPORT_FAILED: This text could not be read. Try again, or enter the recipe by hand.

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.coming_soon: Reactions will be available in a later version.

editor.photo_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. Large photos are made smaller on your phone before upload.
editor.language_hint: Numbers and units are shown the way this language writes them. The recipe is never translated.
editor.visibility_link_hint: Your book, and anyone you send the link to
editor.share: How much of it this step uses
editor.insert_hint: Adds the name and the amount, e.g. “sugar (1 cup)”. Change the word as you like; the amount in brackets follows when the recipe is recalculated.
editor.nothing_to_link: Add ingredients first, or all of them are already in this step.
editor.notes_hint: Tips, what to serve it with, how to store it
editor.leave_confirm: Leave without saving? Your changes will be lost.
editor.not_allowed: Only the author can edit this recipe.
editor.err_minutes: Enter whole minutes (up to 7 days), or leave it empty.
editor.err_amount: Enter an amount like 2, 1.5, ½ or 2–3, or choose “To taste” or “A pinch”.
editor.err_no_ingredients: Add at least one ingredient to publish.
editor.err_no_steps: Add at least one step to publish.
editor.err_shares: An ingredient here is split between steps into more than all of it. Lower its part in one of the steps.
editor.err_timer: Enter the timer length in minutes (up to 24 hours).
editor.err_video: This is not a YouTube link.
editor.err_video_start: Write the start as minutes:seconds, e.g. 1:30.

review.title: Check the recipe
review.intro: We split your text into ingredients and steps. Please check the highlighted lines.
review.reason_p4: The amount comes after the name: check it
review.reason_bracket: A number in brackets was moved to the note
review.reason_unparsed: Not recognized: it stays as written and is not recalculated
review.video_found: YouTube video attached to this step, from {{time}}

dev.design_note: Development only: the design of the import review (Sprint 4). Nothing here is saved.
